label: Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in no respect…, from Whatever is changed in any way is in some… and 2 more
description: Derives STMT-IMMUTABLE-IS-BOETHIAN-ETERNAL (pure act implies typed Boethian eternity: possession of life, no beginning or end, no succession in a duration frame) from the q.9 a.1 succession principle and two open premises, life boundaries require potency and pure act lives. Not a transcription: no premise has eternity as its consequent; the potency premises conclude only potency, and the proof turns each against pure act. Omission controls show each premise is needed; a joint model shows the premises are satisfiable with a pure-act being. It does not close STMT-IMMUTABLE-IS-ETERNAL (primitive Eternal), establish any premise, or exclude dependence on external conservation.
